integrity: Exhaustive finite semisimplicial cell generation, integral boundary Smith computations, cellular free-face collapses, a nonzero two-cocycle modulo integral coboundaries, and the fixed-cell Lefschetz character can be reconstructed using the accompanying standalone checker. This is a same-model scientific review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical five-letter action of AGL(1,5). The degree-three group representation is classified rationally, not as an integral module. No general odd-prime or arbitrary sharply two-transitive theorem is claimed. Unindexed equivalent literature is a residual risk.
title: Mixed-dimensional homotopy and affine symmetry of the five-letter permutation complex
